description_en: Queries EIAM account information by using paging
name: ListUsers

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 列表大小，默认20，最大不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The username prefix. A left-match query is used
parameters.help_zh: 账户名前缀，采用左匹配查询
parameters.name: username_starts_with

parameters.help_en: The display name prefix. A left-match query is used
parameters.help_zh: 账户展示名前缀，采用左匹配查询
parameters.name: display_name_starts_with

parameters.help_en: The phone region code. Example: The region code for the Chinese mainland is 86, without the 00 or + prefix
parameters.help_zh: 手机地区编号,示例：中国大陆手区号为86，不带 00 或 +
parameters.name: phone_region

parameters.help_en: The phone number of the account
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.help_en: The email address of the account
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en:
The external ID, which is used to associate external data with IDaaS accounts.

Note: The external ID must be unique within the same source type and source ID
parameters.help_zh:
外部ID，用于外部数据与IDaaS账户的数据关联映射。

说明：外部ID在同一来源类型和来源ID下唯一
parameters.name: user_external_id

parameters.help_en:
The source ID of the account.

For self-built accounts, the default value is the instance ID. For other types, the value corresponds to the enterprise ID of the respective source. For example, for a DingTalk source, the value corresponds to the corpId of the DingTalk enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
账户来源ID。

自建类型默认为实例ID，其他类型，分别对应不同来源的企业ID，比如钉钉来源对应钉钉企业的corpId
parameters.name: user_source_id

parameters.help_en:
The source type of the account. Valid values:
build_in: self-built.
ding_talk: imported from DingTalk.
ad: imported from AD.
ldap: imported from LDAP.
we_com: imported from WeCom
parameters.help_zh:
账户来源类型，取值可选范围：
build_in：自建。
ding_talk：钉钉导入。
ad：AD导入。
ldap：LDAP导入
we_com：企业微信导入
parameters.name: user_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The account status. Valid values:
enabled: Enabled.
disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
账户状态，取值可选范围：
enabled： 启用中。
disabled： 禁用中
